items.summary: Incyte (INCY) is back in focus following renewed attention on upcoming ESMO data for its KRAS G12D inhibitor, known as 734, which is being studied in combination with chemotherapy for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. items.title: Incyte (INCY) Nears New ESMO Data For KRAS G12D Candidate 734
items.summary: Incyte (NasdaqGS: INCY) is drawing attention as its KRAS G12D inhibitor '734 heads into new data presentations at ESMO, focused on pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
